title: The AI Price War Just Got Brutal
concept: Market scoreboard and aggressive price-drop face-off between new AI models, breaking down token costs with stark kinetic typography and direct product cards.
visual_identity: Industrial brutalist tech theme with stark high-contrast typography, electric crimson and safety yellow accent pulses on deep charcoal and pure white backgrounds.
storytelling_approach: Direct market disruption breakdown: immediate hook establishing the brutal escalation, rapid head-to-head model card comparison, jaw-dropping cost stats, and a user-empowerment takeaway.
hook_visual: A flashing red warning panel stamping the screen with 'PRICE WAR BRUTAL' over a cracking glass texture.
escalation: Rapid sequence introducing Claude Fable's shadow, followed by the lightning-fast drop of OpenAI's Astra and Sol models with tumbling token pricing.
payoff: Final bold question placing the power back into the everyday creator's wallet.
constraints: No camera moves, zooms, or pans

motion_direction.rhythm: Fast, punchy, high-impact cuts aligned with aggressive pricing milestones.
motion_direction.staging_notes: Central vertical alignment with heavy reliance on contrast cards and stat counters in the middle 60% of the screen.

audio_direction.music_direction: Driving industrial synth beat with heavy low-end sub-bass pulses and urgent mechanical rhythms.
audio_direction.ambience_direction: Low-level digital hum with subtle room resonance.
audio_direction.narration_protection: Duck music by 12dB during active speech, keeping transients pristine.

central_composition.element_stacking: Headline on top, clear visual card/stat counter in the absolute center, subtext anchoring the bottom.

typography.scaling_rules: Auto-fit container with strict max-width boundaries.

self_critique.praise: The pricing numbers ($8/$40 and $2/$10) are precisely verified against the source text. Pacing is punchy, structured cleanly with distinct visual beats.
self_critique.improvements: Ensure Remotion safely clamps font sizing on the token price stat beat to prevent text clipping on smaller 9:16 viewports.
self_critique.risk_factors: Fast text transitions require robust text wrapping in Remotion components to avoid overflow.
